summary.content:
Today's selection covers 108 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 70 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Meta A.I. Bug Allowed Hackers to Take Over Instagram Accounts
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Who Runs the Ransomware Group ‘The Gentlemen?’
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, Krebs on Security, Dark Reading, TechCrunch, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 53 articles published in the last 24 hours
